## Failure mode and scope

Describe the real failure mode, the bounded change, and anything intentionally left out.

## Evidence

- [ ] I ran the relevant regression tests.
- [ ] I ran `npm test`, `npm run check:docs`, and `npm run pack:check` when repository behavior or distribution files changed.
- [ ] I ran `git diff --check`.
- [ ] I updated `CHANGELOG.md` and every affected contract/template/example, or explained why no update is needed.
- [ ] I removed credentials, private source, and personal data from the change and its evidence.
- [ ] I did not cross a merge, release, deployment, or project-write Gate without explicit authorization.

## Compatibility and rollback

State the affected layouts/versions, migration needs, and the safe rollback path.
